business_summary: Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of electrical machinery and equipment, building materials, fuels, and shipping-related operations in Japan. The company distributes power distribution control equipment, laser processing machines, ceramics, agricultural facilities, industrial machinery, environmental equipment, measuring and monitoring supervisory control equipment, cement, ready-mixed concrete, road cutting and paving machines, and trucks; air conditioning and sanitation equipment, freezing and refrigerating equipment, elevators, power receiving/transforming facilities, emergency home power generators, power supply systems, parking lot equipment, large-scale mapping devices, building management systems, and security systems; FA and high-performance materials; and industrial equipment and agricultural implements. It also sells construction machinery, such as milling machines, rotary snowplows, asphalt finishers, vibrating rollers, concrete pumps, silent pilers, pile drivers, and telescopic cranes; construction materials; and petroleum products to industry and households. In addition, the company is involved in shipping operations at ports, warehouse management, domestic coastal shipping, boat leasing, irregular overseas shipping and transportation, and customs clearance; sea transport agency; air service agency; motor truck operations; and gas station management. Further, it sells automobile parts, liquefied petroleum gas, other high-pressure gases, boat products, shipping materials, disaster prevention devices, FA systems, and other goods; and repairs automobiles. The company was formerly known as Narasaki Sangyo Kaiun K.K. and changed its name to Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd. in 2002. Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 나라사키 산업(Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd.)은 일본에서 전기 기계 및 장비, 건축 자재, 연료 판매 및 운송 관련 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 배전 제어 장비, 레이저 가공 기계, 세라믹, 농업 시설, 산업 기계, 환경 장비, 측정 및 모니터링 감독 제어 장비, 시멘트, 레미콘, 도로 절단 및 포장 기계, 트럭을 유통합니다. 공조 및 위생 장비, 냉동 및 냉동 장비, 엘리베이터, 수전/변전 시설, 비상 가정용 발전기, 전원 공급 시스템, 주차장 장비, 대규모 매핑 장치, 건물 관리 시스템 및 보안 시스템; FA 및 고성능 소재; 산업 장비 및 농기구. 또한 밀링 머신, 회전식 제설기, 아스팔트 피니셔, 진동 롤러, 콘크리트 펌프, 사일런트 파일러, 파일 드라이버 및 텔레스코픽 크레인과 같은 건설 기계도 판매합니다. 건축자재; 산업 및 가정에 석유 제품을 공급합니다. 또한 회사는 항만에서의 운송 업무, 창고 관리, 국내 운송 업무에 참여하고 있습니다.
